onset.Description: Onset (s) from the start of the recording. For source=TRIG: first sample at which TRIG leaves its resting level (trig_baseline).

duration.Description: For source=TRIG: time (s) until TRIG returned to its resting level. For source_events_tsv: duration from the source events.tsv.

trial_type.Description: 'trigger' = a TRIG pulse. Source README: 'Triggers were sent at the onset of each image; specifically, the trigger channel was set to be above 0 starting at the onset of the screen flip, and was set back to 0 at the end of a screen flip (when the image was presented).' Other values are copied from the source events.tsv (present for sub-3 only in the release).

Levels.trigger: a TRIG pulse decoded from the TRIG channel (one per image onset per the source README)
Levels.ntb_bs_struc2_v2: label copied verbatim from the source events.tsv (sub-3 only); its meaning is not documented in the release

value.Description: For source=TRIG: the sequence of TRIG levels (separated by |) between leaving and returning to the resting level, read from the EDF in physical units (8-bit trigger codes written by the experiment DAQ into the open TRIG channel; the code meanings are not documented in the release). For source_events_tsv: value column of the source file.

trig_baseline.Description: Resting TRIG level of this run (most frequent value; 0, 8 or 16 depending on the participant).

sample.Description: Sample index (0-based) of the onset at the recording sampling rate.

Levels.TRIG: decoded from the TRIG channel of the EDF file
